title: Arkanum Go isolated proof registry
description: Operator reference schema; runtime additionally checks identity/pin uniqueness, SID ownership, RSA key format and directory provenance. JSON names here use canonical casing; the runtime is case-insensitive. No operational identities or keys belong in source control.

ListenAddress.description: IP literal; use a private approved bind address for remote devices.

EnrollmentDirectory.description: Absolute independently protected write-once enrollment-marker directory; physically distinct from and not nested with StateDirectory. Preserve markers independently of sequence-state cleanup and restore.

StateDirectory.description: Absolute protected writable directory; retain durable sequence, enrollment binding and authorization history.

Sid.description: Independently verified AD user SID belonging to DomainSid.

Roles.description: Defined ArkanumRole names or numeric values; actual Web effective reveal policy is required.

UnwrapSpki.description: Canonical Base64 DER RSA SPKI, at least 2048 bits; unique and separate from authentication key.

IssuedAt.description: Immutable enrollment issuance, NOT grant issuance or expiry; do not edit for refresh.

UserIds.description: Optional legacy compatibility metadata only; ignored for all authorization. Omit from new registries.

MemberUserIds.description: Existing user-vault membership is the sole user assignment source. Each referenced member must satisfy effective reveal policy or the proof conservatively denies the device.
